supported.title: Supported watches
supported.intro: JoyoFit talks directly to Huawei and Honor watches. Only one model has been tested on a real watch.

status.experimental: Experimental: in the list, never tried with JoyoFit
status.notYet: Not yet: the newer pairing is not built

supported.footer: A Huawei or Honor watch that is not listed is still tried. Other brands, and earbuds, cannot be paired. JoyoFit is useful without a watch too: log strength workouts, use Coach and browse the exercise library.

intro.title: A watch is optional
intro.body: Strength logging, Coach and the exercise library work without a watch. A Huawei or Honor watch adds steps, sleep, heart rate and daily readiness to Today.
intro.permission: If you continue, your phone may ask for Bluetooth permission so JoyoFit can find watches nearby.
